gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) width and mesangial expansion: Measured by morphometric examination of kidney tissue

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary objective of this study is to determine whether canagliflozin affects intrarenal transcripts of energy metabolism in adults with type 2 diabetes and early DKD.

role_evidence.quote: All participants will be receive 100 mg/daily doses of Canagliflozin (INVOKANA) for 6 months.

coder_notes: Not a glioblastoma trial: 'GBM' here means glomerular basement membrane (kidney morphometry in diabetic kidney disease), not glioblastoma and not anti-GBM disease, so coded not_glioblastoma. Canagliflozin is the only investigational agent (role experimental_monotherapy by rule 4) but is tested for renal effects with no antitumour hypothesis, so there is no pharmacological antitumour candidate (S6 no_pharmacological_candidate). Kidney transcript endpoints are renal pharmacodynamics, not tumour target engagement. Treatment setting not applicable to a non-tumour trial; coded unclear. Phase 4.
